input.reason: a stray folder named newname_nether already exists (e.g. from an earlier failed attempt)

notes: Before renameWorld moves anything, it loops over every target name (world/world_nether/world_the_end -> newname/newname_nether/newname_the_end) and refuses the whole operation if any single one already exists (lines 190-198) -- this is an all-or-nothing pre-check, not a per-folder decision made during the move loop, so a rename can never partially fail because of a naming collision discovered mid-sequence. This is distinct from the mid-sequence *I/O* failure case (rename-world-rollback-on-mid-sequence-move-failure), where the pre-check passes but a later moveItem call throws.
